Task: Summarize the plot of any Shakespeare play in three sentences.

Spurred by a witches' prophecy and his wife's ruthless ambition, the Scottish general Macbeth murders King Duncan to seize the throne. Consumed by paranoia and a desire to maintain power, Macbeth descends into tyranny, ordering the deaths of those he suspects of treason, including his friend Banquo. Ultimately, his guilt-ridden wife takes her own life and Macbeth is slain in battle by Macduff, restoring the rightful heir to the Scottish crown.

This task took me approximately 2.3 seconds to complete.
